notes.title: Cash Rush V.2 !
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33339753/5a84b4fd454d1460ab063eae6c52d73a716c650a.png[/img]
[h1]Version 2 changelog[/h1]

[b]Saving system ![/b]
[list]
	[*]You can finally quit the game whenever you want,
	the button "Load" will appear in the menu.
[/list]

[b]Graphics overhaul ![/b]
[list]
	 [*]Every sprites have been remade.
	 [*]A fresh and more convenient HUD with a new font.
         [*]You only see the silhouette when you have not unlocked a product.
	 [*]New animation when you move a piece furniture.
         [*]New background & walls & ground.
	 [*]Size of the shop has been adjusted to stick with 16:9 ratio.
[/list]

[b]More content & Gameplay adjustment![/b]
[list]
    [*]2 new categories of product have been added : Sushis & Toys
    [*]Moving the camera can now be done with the right click.
    [*]The game is more balance
    [*]You don't have to wait anymore when you hire a new employee.
    [*]Lots of small bugs fixed.
[/list]

Might be some other stuff but I've probably forgotten, lol.
AVAILABLE IN FEW HOURS !

ENJOY !
